title: XTP and provisioning continuity decision ledger

records.value: XTP dev25, planner dev5 and Storage dev23 are development ZIP heads; not a promotion claim

records.rule: Service name -> registered operational class -> logical peer -> service point. Carrier addresses only in XTP route configuration.
SAMPLE/AGGREGATE requires upstream transform, not silent forwarding of original.
normal.storage 30% per context, max 2, aggregate 60%; capacity contraction 100 to 50 scales two grants 30/30 to 15/15.
Cryptographically verify received object ranges; multicast offers are hints, not authentication; reassign missing range only.
ROUTE/XROUTE endpoint exchange is not a secure service-publication directory or full multi-hop router.
xtp.provision offers DHCP-like approved signed configuration lifecycle via pre-established authorised XTP context, never DNS-style lookup.
Default 3 controllers 2-of-3, paired use 2-of-2; signatures without fenced durable authority consensus do not commit.
Reject effectful remote provisioning until session-authenticated, encrypted, authorised KEY binding is field-qualified.
Never overwrite seed routes/trust anchors with downloaded allocation.
Named FIRST->DATA persistent XTP context remains experimental across raw36/L2.
Offline signed-record tests/local native UDP are separate evidence from ED209 raw36 and L2.
